name: Pew-Pew!

gist.Bow Sniper Darge: Each Arrow she plays in reaction to his single-target attack adds a large bonus on top of the Arrow's own effect.
gist.Kazena, the Storming Rebel: Once per turn draws her hand back up to seven cards.
gist.Treasure Huntress Semi: Extra gold every turn, which pays for the Arrows.
gist.Angelfeather Arrow: Reaction to her own attack: plain extra damage.
gist.Flame Arrow: A little damage and the target burns for good.
gist.Poisoned Arrow: A little damage and a stack of poison.
gist.Bomb Arrow: A little damage and a solid hit on a creature.
gist.Rainbow's Arrow: A little damage and two cards.
gist.Golden Arrow: Free: pays gold in proportion to the attack's damage, but locks her gold for the turn.
gist.Arrow Slit: Makes an Arrow she just played happen twice.
gist.Archer: Free creature (for a discarded Arrow) that stings a target for each Arrow played, up to three a turn.
gist.Quick Attack: A free first attack each turn: a second volley.
gist.Hammer Throw: Attack that makes your next artifacts cost you cards.
gist.Ferocious Tiger Kick: Attack that stuns; as the second attack of a turn it also heals.

plan: One arrow at a time, very hard. Priya attacks with Darge and answers her own attack with a fan of Arrow artifacts: each adds an effect, each adds Darge's bonus, Arrow Slit doubles one. Quick Attack gives a second volley the same turn, an Archer adds stings, Kazena refills the hand every turn and Semi pays for it. A well-fed Darge shot removes a hero. The deck is disciplined and narrow: the damage is single-target and announced, the Arrows cost gold she has to budget, and everything depends on a fragile sniper getting to attack.

looks.early: An Archer, a little stack of gold, Darge with Fighting levelled.
looks.mid: Darge with four Arrows fanned behind him; one of your heroes burning and poisoned; Kazena drawing back to seven.
looks.late: Gold spent, Darge exposed after a huge volley.

opening.tell: She is saving gold and Arrows; only an Archer is on the board.
opening.why: Her first real volley is a few turns away and her damage will be one announced attack per turn: level up now and put Firewall face-down on the hero she must shoot.

midgame.tell: Darge has a full fan of Arrows behind him and gold to play them all.
midgame.why: A frozen Darge cannot attack at all, and Kazena, who refills that fan every turn, has ordinary health; waiting only lets the volley come at full size.

crisis.tell: She has just spent her gold on one enormous shot and Darge has very little health.
crisis.why: After a volley she cannot pay for another this turn cycle; the sniper is the smallest hero on the table and there is nothing to sweep.

endgame.tell: Her last attacker gets one swing a turn, with whatever Arrows she can still afford.
endgame.why: A single announced hit per turn is what Homerun!, Cloud in a Bottle and a freeze are for; blunt it and the Storm finishes.

opening.board: Priya summons an Archer by discarding an Arrow and banks her gold.
Kazena draws her back to seven; she attaches Fighting to Darge and passes.
A first Quick Attack with a Poisoned Arrow tests your caster.

midgame.board: Darge draws his bow with four Arrows ready and gold to match.
The volley lands on your Firewall hero: Darge is burned and hurt, your hero nearly gone.

options.text: Burn Kazena so the fan does not refill
Cloud in a Bottle, answer on Darge

midgame.board: Arrow Slit doubles a Flame Arrow: two of your heroes burn.

options.text: Freeze Darge, Tea a burn onto him

crisis.board: One of your heroes is gone to a single shot; her gold is spent and Darge is wounded.
Golden Arrow refunds her gold but she cannot spend it this turn.

options.text: This turn she cannot answer anything: strike
Storm ticks through the stun; burn Darge with the others

endgame.board: Kazena is her last attacker, swinging once a turn.

options.text: Homerun! for the hit, tick her down

endgame.board: One hero each; she needs one more volley.

options.text: Snow Cannon now, Flashbang next turn

endgame.board: Darge returns on a Golden Ankh for one last shot.

options.text: Cloud in a Bottle on the target
